title: Star Wars T-Shirt Club should have actual Star Wars shirts
text: Just because something has the word Star Wars on it does not make it a Star Wars shirt.  This item is completely misleading. I got the subscription for myself and a friend, figured this would make a great gift for a fellow Star Wars Fan. This shirt was an anime collage with the words Star War written on the bottom above some other Asian characters. This was completely misleading. I'm sure other months may be fine but this was not. I am disappointed and slightly angry.
label: negative
